messages.subject: Re: Rattle Combo Box
messages.body_plain:
Hi Marco,

Received Sun 01 Oct 2006  1:37am +1000 from Marco LO:

> Hello There,
>
>   I added a combo box on Rattle with the following piece of code:
>
>   update_continuous_variable <- function(action, window)
> {
>   vl <- unlist(sapply(colnames(crs$dataset),
>                       function(x)
>                       {
>                         cmd <- sprintf("is.integer(%s)", x)
>                         var <- try(ifelse(eval(parse(text=cmd), crs$dataset),
>                                           x, NULL), silent=TRUE)
>                         if (inherits(var, "try-error"))
>                           var <- NULL
>                         return(var)
>                       }))
>   if (! is.null(vl))
>   {
>     action$getModel()$clear()
>     lapply(vl, action$appendText)
>   }
> }
>
> However, whenever I leave focus from the combo box, the selection in
> the box will be cleared.  What I missed in the code?

Nothing sticks out as a problem. Your code is probably modelled on
update_comboboxentry_with_dataframes. Do you see the same behaviour
with that combobox?

> In general, where I could locate more information on Glade-RGtk2 to
> learn the coding in Rattle?

Unfortunately there is next to nothing specific to RGtk. But it is a
direct mapping of the GTK and Glade libraries, so the general GTK and
Glade API docs can help, but it is not always easy.

Regards,
Graham
